name: Soham Paul
summary: Spoke with the student, Soham Paul, who is already a B.Tech CSE AIML student at Adamas University. He was interested in M.Tech programs for the 2027 session. I shared the eligibility criteria (60% in B.Tech + GATE/AUAT) and fee details (First Sem Fee 78,250, Total Fee 3,51,800) for the M.Tech programs. He had no further questions and ended the call.
